one_line: OpenAI and Microsoft release new AI models, while major funding rounds and export control scrutiny shape the industry.

themes.title: OpenAI and Microsoft release new models
themes.text: OpenAI released GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol across ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API, while Microsoft unveiled six new models including MAI Code 2 and Flash on GitHub Copilot.

stories.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol for ChatGPT Work and Codex
Microsoft unveils six AI models including MAI Code 2 and Flash

themes.title: Major funding rounds and investments announced
themes.text: Altimeter aims to invest $5 billion in the Anthropic IPO, Isomorphic Labs raised a $5 billion Series C, Genesis AI secured $500 million, and Numa raised $45 million.

stories.headline: Altimeter aims to invest $5B in Anthropic IPO
Isomorphic Labs raises $5 billion Series C to speed AI‑driven drug trials
Genesis AI raises $500 million Series A at $3.5 billion valuation
Numa raises $45M Series C to expand AI operating system for car dealerships

themes.title: Nvidia leadership changes and export controls
themes.text: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is scheduled to testify before US House committees following his resignation amid a scandal, while the US tightened chip export rules and investigated Singapore-based entities.

stories.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to testify before US House committees on Dec 1
Nvidia stopped reporting Singapore unit revenue in 2025 as it hit $104B
US Commerce Dept and DOJ investigated Megaspeed over chip exports in 2024
Nvidia board creates National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee
Nvidia faces third-quarter earnings call under interim CEO Colette Kress
US tightens AI chip export rules, targeting Southeast Asia data centres

themes.title: Data center power use and expansion hurdles
themes.text: A Harvard study revealed that 403 US hyperscale data centers consumed 82 terawatt-hours of electricity, and Amazon's Ohio data center plans face obstacles following voter restrictions.

stories.headline: Harvard study estimates power use of 403 US hyperscale data centers
Amazon's Ohio data center plans face risks after voter restrictions
